_doc: Kev hand-to-hand plan. h2h.py reads every weapon moveset as an enemy profile (reach from the weapon length, speed from its light windups, ranged from `aim`), times each strike below from its own motion (hand speed against the pelvis), then picks a chain per enemy by minimising transition cost plus the rule weights. Hand strikes must come from UAL or Kevin libraries (`hand_strike_libs`), the user's rule.

rules._target_doc: target_weight: cost removed per unit of mean landing score (head 2, torso 1, leg 0.25, over 0; targets.py) on target_rig, the body the game's enemies wear. other_rigs are planned for the report only.
rules._variety_doc: variety_slack: a weapon takes the cheapest chain no earlier weapon uses, if it costs at most this much over its best.

_doc_tempo: Windup weight applies only to the part of a strike's windup longer than the enemy's windup (seconds).
_doc_crossfade: crossfade_hides_deg: pose+motion mismatch (degrees) that the chained-attack crossfade is assumed to hide. An assumption: lower it if cuts look visible in game.
_doc_chain: A strike whose window ends with the striking hand faster than mid_swing_mps and not drawing back (radial speed >= -retract_mps) is mid-swing: it only closes a chain, its recovery plays after. A hand drawing back to the guard is a recovery and may be cut. facing_weight: cost per degree the hips turn across a cut.
